toni_m: Quick PR up to tighten the quotas page examples and fix a broken dashboard link. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/49901

samir_p: Will review. Can you keep header names lowercase and show a tiny curl example for attribution?

toni_m: Updated. Snippet uses `x-redwood-quota-tenant` and notes service tokens only.

ivy_d: Also add a 1-line FAQ: do quotas apply immediately after tier change? Answer: usually, but migrations/grace windows can delay; include x-request-id when filing support tickets.

docs-bot: lint check passed for PR #49901 (2 checks).

toni_m: Merging after minor copy fix. Added public grafana snapshot link to replace the internal dashboard.
